nodes.description: payable address payowner that receives mint fees from claim()
mapping(address => uint256) _claimTimes tracking how many times an address claimed
uint256 _globalTokenId, incrementing global token id starting at 1
receive() external payable that forwards all plain ETH transfers into claim()
claim() public payable nonReentrant minting entry point; checks msg.value, pays owner, mints and updates counters
_safeMint internal, mints token then performs ERC721 receiver callback check
_checkOnERC721Received private, external call to recipient contract if it is a contract
transferOwnership guarded by onlyOwner access control
tokenURI override building on-chain SVG + JSON metadata
pluck internal view deriving loot attributes from pseudo-randomness
random internal pure keccak256 based number generator
msg.sender, caller controlled address used as claim key and mint recipient
payowner.transfer(msg.value) external value transfer executed before mint state updates
external call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled recipient contract
_globalTokenId++ arithmetic mutation of mint counter
_claimTimes[msg.sender] = ++times arithmetic mutation of per-address claim counter
uint256 tokenId parameter supplied by caller to tokenURI and pluck
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
uint256 times local copy of _claimTimes[msg.sender] inside claim
uint256 rand local pseudo-random value inside pluck

edges.reason: receive() forwards incoming ether directly into claim(), making claim reachable without calldata
claim() reads msg.sender as the claimer and mint recipient
msg.sender is used as the key into the _claimTimes mapping
claim() pushes msg.value to payowner via transfer before finishing state updates, an external value transfer
claim() invokes _safeMint which can re-enter through the receiver callback
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received for the recipient
_checkOnERC721Received performs an untrusted external call to onERC721Received on the recipient contract
claim() executes _globalTokenId++ to advance the mint counter
the increment operation writes the new value into state variable _globalTokenId
claim() executes ++times to update the caller claim count
the incremented counter is stored back into _claimTimes[msg.sender]
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares owner() with _msgSender()
tokenURI calls getWeapon/getChest/getRing which all delegate to pluck
the caller supplied tokenId parameter flows into pluck to derive attributes
pluck calls random() to derive the pseudo-random seed
pluck stores the random() result in the local variable rand
tokenId parameter is used by tokenURI for metadata generation and existence check
newOwner parameter is validated and written by transferOwnership
claim() loads _claimTimes[msg.sender] into the local variable times
the local variable times is pre-incremented to form the new claim counter value

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId is only a caller-supplied argument consumed by tokenURI (and its pluck helper) for attribute/metadata derivation; folding it into the tokenURI function node removes a transient parameter node.
newOwner exists solely as the input of the access-controlled transferOwnership function and has no independent semantic role.
the local times variable is a temporary snapshot used only to compute the ++ increment of _claimTimes, so it collapses into the claim-time mutation operation.
rand is a transient internal value computed and consumed entirely inside pluck for attribute selection, so it merges into the pluck function node.
